verdict.rationale: GitBook documents its own two-way GitHub/GitLab Sync and Markdown-based editing, which plausibly lets content live in a user-controlled Git repo in an open format. The evidence never explicitly describes a full data export or an exit path. missing for 10: explicit documentation that Git Sync writes all content as Markdown, export of non-page data (comments, change requests, analytics, settings), a dedicated bulk export or offboarding feature, independent hands-on confirmation of a clean migration out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: with Markdown, real-time collaboration, version control, and Git workflows built in
